scope.purpose: Skip adjustment when both displayed MP level and bar match; repair either mismatch.
scope.fixture: Explicit first_join, frozen ticks, MP/MPMax and XP drift are fixtures. Direct private function calls are diagnostic boundaries. $NowMP sentinel observes adjust_xpbar cleanup; production functions are unchanged by the test.

steps.name: Explicit player initialization in frozen test world
commands: gamerule doMobSpawning false
gamemode creative VerifyMP
execute as VerifyMP at @s run function core:handler/first_join
fill -3 79 -3 3 79 3 stone
tp VerifyMP 0.5 80 0.5
clear VerifyMP
scoreboard objectives add MPVerify dummy
scoreboard players set READY MPVerify 1

steps.name: zero
commands: scoreboard players set VerifyMP MP 0
scoreboard players set VerifyMP MPMax 1000
execute as VerifyMP run function api:data_get/invalidate_cache
execute as VerifyMP at @s run function player_manager:mp/viewer/check_xpbar
scoreboard players set $NowMP Temporary 314159
execute as VerifyMP run function api:data_get/invalidate_cache
execute as VerifyMP at @s run function player_manager:mp/viewer/check_xpbar
execute store result score LEVEL MPVerify run xp query VerifyMP levels
execute store result score BAR MPVerify run data get entity VerifyMP XpP 1000000
execute if score $NowMP Temporary matches 314159 if score LEVEL MPVerify matches 0 if score BAR MPVerify matches 0..2 run scoreboard players set ZERO MPVerify 1
scoreboard players reset $NowMP Temporary
